scope: Independent root Window/Bridge/main additive week integration and new integration tests; own core/adapter/tests excluded from independent credit
checks: One active optional Statistics slot; saved totals keep independent pending work, daily/week share latest date/mode slot and monotonic historyRequest counter.

Daily rejects active week; week requires explicit kind,session,request,endingDate before clearing active work. Saved totals reject every history kind. Current page identity/session and inner view generations independently gate mutation.

Pending saved totals preserve priority. Direct rejection/no busy packet and busyfalse/no-result fail only matching active kind; later pending work remains. QTimer dispatch is QObject-bound and active state installs before emitting.

Worker uses existing private Host held lease and exact week adapter. Cancellation checkpoints surround read/allocation/publication, GUI callback rechecks stop/session, packet publishes with busy held and QPointer deletion guard before subsequent member access.
Optional dispatch uses recoverLibrarySnapshot=false; read/parse/cancel failures cannot query saved Library or increment snapshot revision. No new thread/lease/network or history writes.

New profile clears active/pending work and resets both views before refreshing selected mode. Statistics close discards pending work without cancelling unrelated active work; old page pointer cannot retarget reopened page.
F5 prioritizes selected7days thenDaily else saved totals; permanent saved-total Refresh remains independently routed. Main production connects matching typed signal/slots.

Root test profiles are QTemporaryDir generated, expected raw histories are parser-derived fixtures, Bridge stack lifetime ends before Window/profile. No live client/profile or payload/network fixtures.

Integration assertions cover actual seven-row missing/empty/zero, immutable old frame after refresh, unchanged daily/tab/filter state, kind/date rejection, pending coalescing and saved-total priority, close/reopen/new-session rejection, direct callback busy/reentry, immediate queued cancel and Window deletion.
Literal inverse recipe changes recover all five previous qualified source hashes exactly; no target recipe was imported or evaluated.
scope_precision: Cancellation row covers direct GUI cancellation before queued packet publication; deterministic mid-file read cancellation is separately authored in adapter tests, not runtime-credited here.
Profile change row is Window session replacement with synthetic packets, not an independently executed second real Bridge Host/profile switch.
Window deletion during request dispatch is covered; this new suite does not independently claim Bridge deletion during week publication.
Input integrity helper binds bytes/device/inode and absence of selected day backup/saving files; it does not claim full metadata or directory inventory equality.
